With seed 0 and [learning rate](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-learning-rate) 0.1,
a network of [width](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/neural-nets.html#def-width) 32 reaches validation [accuracy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/metrics.html#def-accuracy) `r sprintf("%.3f", py$narrow_seed0)`,
and one of width 64 reaches `r sprintf("%.3f", py$wide_seed0)`.
